_doc: How lupin matches marker-panel cell-type labels to Cell Ontology terms. Layered: this file, then ~/.config/lupin/cl_matching.json, then <run dir>/lupin/cl_matching.json; later files override the keys they set. See `lupin data where`.

synonyms._doc: synonym scope -> synonym types that count; [] = every synonym of that scope. OMO:0003000 marks abbreviations (HSC, CMP, GMP), OMO:0003004 plural forms (microglia).

classes._doc: Terms in these OBO subsets are the analysis classes panel types are grouped under.

plural._doc: Trailing word replacements, then a trailing 's' dropped from words of at least min_len letters (not 'ss').

implied._doc: Words a label may leave off its end: a label that matches no term is tried again with each appended (Immature_B -> immature B cell), taking the first that completes exactly one term's name (not a synonym).

qualifiers._doc: A term is also known without a trailing taxon in parentheses ('(Mmus)', '(sensu Vertebrata)') or one plain word after a comma (', human'); a text that then names a term and its specialisations takes the most general.

_compact: As a last resort, compare without spaces and hyphens (Pro-Erythroblast -> proerythroblast).

contained._doc: A label of at least min_words words (an implied one not counted) that a term's own name (not a synonym) spells out among other words takes the most general such term, else the one whose name adds the fewest words (CD4 Central Memory -> central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell; X+ and X-positive are X). null turns it off.

context._doc: A word the panel leaves off its labels (a tissue): the one word that, with an implied one, completes a term's name or counted synonym for at least min_labels labels nothing else matched, and for more than any other word (Alpha, Beta, Ductal -> pancreatic ...). null turns it off.
